description: Implement ITERATE-TO-BEST: ONE shared fused quality-gated acceptance decision in evalloop.py that fuses deterministic verification (tests/build + Layer-1) with the Phase-2 reviewer gate (scan.apply_thresholds against review.thresholds), folds the exact structured scanner findings into evalloop's existing structured failure report, tracks best-so-far across iterations, and enforces convergence/stop/ask bounded by max_iterations. Make the three existing callers (verify.py --iterate, scaffold.decide_generation, orchestrate.decide_task) delegate to this SAME function so 'best' means the same thing everywhere. Reuse scan.apply_thresholds + scan.make_finding + the existing evalloop cap/budget/acceptance primitives; do NOT fork a parallel path or reimplement threshold logic.
steps: evalloop.py: extend build_failure_report(summary, eval_data=None, scan_gate=None, findings=None) so that when a reviewer gate FAILS it folds the EXACT normalized scanner findings (severity, category, file, line, rule, message, source_tool - the shape scan.make_finding emits) and the gate block (passed/fail_on_severity/failing_severities/failing_counts/reasons) into the SAME structured report under new keys (e.g. 'reviewer_gate' and 'scanner_findings'). Keep all existing keys intact. Preserve the fail-loud contract: a reviewer-gate failure now counts as a real failure so an all-green verify + failing gate still produces a report (never an empty 'all clear'). Keep the function JSON-serializable and compact.

evalloop.py: add a reviewer-gate resolver that REUSES scan.apply_thresholds and the SAME review.thresholds block scan.load_review_config/resolve_thresholds already read (REPO-FIRST, package fallback). Do not reimplement threshold logic. Add any iterate-to-best knobs ONLY under existing config structures: under review.thresholds and/or eval_data (e.g. eval_data.iterate_to_best with sub-keys like gate_categories, include_limitations, best_so_far tie-break policy). Resolver functions must default safely when config/PyYAML is missing (mirror resolve_max_iterations).

evalloop.py: add a 'best-so-far' scorer that ranks an iteration by residual severity (fewest/lowest-severity residual findings + verify failing-phase count) so the loop can track and report the BEST iteration reached across attempts, not merely the last. Keep it deterministic and tie-broken by the configured policy.

evalloop.py: introduce the SINGLE shared function evaluate_quality_gated(repo_path, adapter, options=None, state=None) that: (a) runs the existing deterministic cycle (run_iteration_cycle - tests/build + Layer-1); (b) resolves + applies the reviewer gate via scan.apply_thresholds against review.thresholds using scanner findings supplied in options['findings'] (the LIVE scan output or a scripted worked-example) or, when a repo+adapter scan is feasible, assembled off-model; (c) acceptance = verify green AND Layer-1 green AND reviewer gate passed => status 'green'/'converged'; (d) otherwise folds findings into build_failure_report and returns needs_fix; (e) honors the anti-circularity acceptance gate (reuse acceptance_criteria_confirmed) and the HARD max_iterations cap exactly like evaluate; (f) threads best-so-far through state so on hitting the cap it STOPS and asks with the BEST iteration + a specific residual summary (not necessarily the last attempt). Reuse LoopState; extend it minimally (e.g. a best_so_far field) without breaking existing callers.

evalloop.py: make the existing evaluate() delegate to evaluate_quality_gated (or share its core) so the standalone loop's semantics are identical and existing evaluate() behavior/tests remain green. If a reviewer gate is not configured/available, the fused decision degrades to the current tests-green behavior (backward compatible).

verify.py: wire the --iterate CLI path to the fused decision. Add an optional way to supply scanner findings (e.g. --findings <json> pointing at scan.py --json output or an inline worked-example) so a headless proof can drive green+gate-fail. When no findings are supplied, behavior matches today (tests-green). Update _format_iterate_human to render the reviewer-gate dimension, best-so-far, and the residual summary on stop. Keep lazy evalloop import + no-network/no-LLM discipline.

scaffold.py: refactor decide_generation so its gate+verify+cap+best-so-far decision DELEGATES to evalloop.evaluate_quality_gated (passing the generation verify_result + reviewer findings) instead of locally recomputing the converged/continue/stop branches. generation_gate stays a thin pass-through to scan.apply_thresholds. Preserve the honest-partial shape semantics (an honest-partial shape can NEVER be 'green') and the existing decide_generation return contract/keys so test_scaffold and test_generation_e2e stay green.

orchestrate.py: verify decide_task automatically picks up the fused decision through the shared evalloop.evaluate / scaffold.decide_generation it already calls; adjust only if the routing needs the new findings input threaded through 'inputs'. Keep recording the engine verdict verbatim.

.apia/config.yml: reuse review.thresholds as the quality bar. Add the iterate-to-best knobs under the EXISTING structures (do NOT add a new top-level parallel block): document them in the existing review/eval_data comment blocks. Keep every existing key intact.

Keep the no-LLM/no-network guard green: ensure evaluate_quality_gated and the extended report import nothing network/LLM and spawn no subprocess directly (only via verify/scan's existing local chokepoints). Extend the tripwire guard test coverage if a new module path is introduced.
acceptance_criteria: evaluate_quality_gated exists in evalloop.py as the single fused decision and is delegated to by verify.py --iterate, scaffold.decide_generation, and orchestrate.decide_task (through the functions it already calls).
A green verify + a reviewer gate that PASSES returns status green/converged.
A green verify + a reviewer gate that FAILS returns needs_fix with the EXACT scanner findings AND the gate block folded into the structured failure report (existing keys preserved).
The reviewer gate reuses scan.apply_thresholds and the SAME review.thresholds; no threshold logic is reimplemented.
best-so-far is tracked across iterations; on hitting the HARD max_iterations cap the decision STOPS and asks, carrying the BEST iteration reached + a specific residual-findings summary.
All iterate-to-best config knobs live under existing review/eval_data structures; existing config keys are unchanged.
scripts contain zero external-LLM/network imports; the no-LLM/no-network tripwire remains green.
verification: .venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests/ -q (timeout >= 600000 ms) still passes the full suite
findings: Implemented the single shared fused decision evalloop.evaluate_quality_gated(repo_path, adapter, options, state). evaluate() is now a thin delegate to it (backward compatible: when no options['findings'] are supplied the reviewer gate is 'not in play' and the decision degrades to today's tests-green path, so all existing evaluate() tests stayed green). Key design points for later features: (1) build_failure_report gained two optional params scan_gate+findings; when a gate FAILS it folds the EXACT scan.apply_thresholds block under report['reviewer_gate'] and the exact normalized findings under report['scanner_findings'], all existing keys preserved, and a gate failure now counts as a real failure so green-verify+failing-gate still yields a report (fail-loud intact). (2) The reviewer gate REUSES scan.load_review_config+resolve_thresholds+apply_thresholds via new resolve_review_thresholds(); no threshold logic reimplemented. scan.py is imported at module top (stdlib-only, no-network guard still green). (3) best-so-far: score_iteration()+_is_better()+_residual_summary(); LoopState gained a best_so_far field (additive, to_dict now returns it too). tie-break knob is eval_data.iterate_to_best.best_so_far_tie_break (fewest_findings|latest|earliest) resolved by resolve_iterate_to_best(). (4) evaluate_quality_gated accepts options['cycle'] as a PRECOMPUTED run_iteration_cycle result so scaffold.decide_generation can delegate WITHOUT re-running verify (it already has a live generation verify_result); decide_generation maps the fused status back to its contract green/iterate/stop/ask and preserves honest-partial (partial can never be green) + all return keys. (5) orchestrate.decide_task needed NO code change: findings thread through inputs['options']['findings'] into evaluate automatically; only the docstring was updated. (6) verify.py --iterate gained --findings <json> (accepts a raw findings list OR a scan report with a 'findings' key); _format_iterate_human now renders the reviewer-gate line, best-so-far, and residual summary. repo_path None is tolerated in evaluate_quality_gated (scaffold passes None for a not-yet-materialized target). Config knobs added only under existing eval_data (iterate_to_best) and the review block comment; no new top-level block; existing keys unchanged. Full suite: 275 passed (~218s). Verified end-to-end on samples/pyapp: green tests + injected high finding => STOP at cap with best-so-far + specific ask (exit 2); no --findings => GREEN (exit 0, backward compatible).
